entries.title: Phoenix / twin turbo cannons, core laser and dark lava
entries.note: Actual native Furious4100HP Phoenix checkpoint; other life bars cleared before capture. Invulnerable input-only observer, native guns/Retina and no recorder HP/phase/clock writes. Four physical barrel mouths alternate rapid twin-pod pairs in straight southbound bullet streams; ordinary bullets cannot be intercepted. Only the measured orange chest core casts lasers, with source-authored1015 charge, committed coloured FOV and one warm beam. Visible-fire evasion has bounded movement and recovery. Darker animated lava has48px independently animated side strips pinned to viewport edges. Native cannon HP gates, breaks, later swoon and copied-life defeat remain. Normal/Hard/Furious escape paths separately verified without GOD.
